source_dispositions.disposition: The selector names Quinate degradation and Shikimate kinase containing cluster. It contains no subsystem role/organism mechanism in this selector; the former remains a reusable-source lead and the latter is a distinct kinase context, not the selected oxidative shikimate catabolic route.
The shikimate/quinate-name hits belong to M00022 chorismate biosynthesis and M00039 monolignol biosynthesis. Neither is the PQQ-dependent two-step shikimate-to-protocatechuate boundary.
Local DRAM adapter output repeats the pinned original rows; it is not independent pathway evidence.
The quiA/quiC substring hits are supplier/method spellings rather than the pathway genes.
